LESSON: PRINTING MAKING

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: PICTURE
Topic 1.3: Printing MAKING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Printing MAKING. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify printing materials
2. develop simple printing tools
3. create patterns using different objects for creativity
4. appreciate own and other pupils work their printed materials using mobile phones or digital cameras

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify printing materials
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify printing materials. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. develop simple printing tools
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to develop simple printing tools. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. create patterns using different objects for creativity
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to create patterns using different objects for creativity. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. appreciate own and other pupils work their printed materials using mobile phones or digital cameras
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate own and other pupils work their printed materials using mobile phones or digital cameras. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Printing MAKING.
2. Explain Printing MAKING to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Printing MAKING.
4. Show that you can: identify printing materials
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Printing MAKING. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Printing MAKING important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify printing materials
2. develop simple printing tools
3. create patterns using different objects for creativity
4. appreciate own and other pupils work their printed materials using mobile phones or digital cameras

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
